subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable `systemPromptReport` representation should OpenClaw keep in retained session entries?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but choosing minimal inline summary, active-only retention, or out-of-line full reports changes session metadata semantics and diagnostic behavior.

options.title: Persist Minimal Durable Summary
options.body: Keep only warning-dedupe and small diagnostic fields inline, and drop or externalize large `tools`, `skills`, and injected-file arrays from retained rows.

options.title: Store Full Reports Out Of Line
options.body: Move full reports behind a content hash or session artifact and keep `sessions.json` as a lightweight index with explicit cleanup ownership.

options.title: Retain Full Reports Only For Active Sessions
options.body: Keep the full report for the current active row but strip it from stale entries during write-time or maintenance compaction.

recommendation.title: Persist Minimal Durable Summary
recommendation.body: Keep only warning-dedupe and small diagnostic fields inline, and drop or externalize large `tools`, `skills`, and injected-file arrays from retained rows.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history across the prompt-report feature and the adjacent persisted prompt-blob mitigation.
